text:
elaine: Quick UX/ a11y check — invite tile on org settings (compact mode). When you tab into the tile, focus hits the avatar then the project name, then the role pill, then the CTA. Problem: screen reader reads the role pill before the invite CTA (primary action). feels wrong for keyboard-first flows. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/invite-tile-compact.png :eyes: sam: Can you paste the DOM order? might be an easy fix with tabindex or reordering the DOM, not just visual order. elain: DOM is currently: avatar > title > role-pill > actions (Invite, More). Visual layout places Invite visually right of role-pill but we use flex-reverse for small screens. so DOM != visual. anika: For screen readers we should keep action buttons immediately after the title in DOM so users hear "Project X, invite button". Also aria-labels on the role pill are noisy: currently "Role: Developer — editable". maybe simplify. mohit: Flagging implementation constraints: moving Invite earlier in DOM can break CSS and affect focus styles. Another option: use aria-flowto or aria-describedby to guide SR? not ideal. elain: Quick proposal: keep DOM order as title -> invite button -> role-pill (visually reorder role-pill with CSS grid). Add aria-label on invite: "Invite to Project X, primary". Reduce role pill SR text to just "Developer role". sam: Feels reasonable. Implementation sketch: ```

Project X

Developer
/* use CSS grid to place .role before .invite visually on small screens */ ``` We'd also need to ensure :focus-visible outlines still match new order. anika: Also add an offscreen-only description for invite button when role is already assigned: "Invite — user will receive role Developer" so SR users know the result. But don't clutter default button label. mohit: Ok. I'd prefer not to use aria-flowto. CSS visual reorder + DOM reorder + SR-only extra text sounds best. Performance: minimal DOM changes. elain: Accessibility nit: tab order should not include the 3-dot menu until after Invite and role pill. Current tab hits menu after avatar which is weird. We'll reorder that too. sam: I'll prototype a small change in the component and drop a PR. Will include screenshots and VoiceOver notes. aria-bot: Accessibility checklist: 1) DOM action order reflects logical action priority; 2) Button aria-labels concise; 3) Role pill SR text simplified; 4) 3-dot menu moved after primary actions; 5) Focus indicators preserved. elain: Thanks — can we land this on beta before next design review? tiny copy change: Invite aria-label should be "Invite people to Project X" not just "Invite". anika: Agree. Also ensure contrast of role pill when it becomes interactive meets AA (4.5:1) — currently borderline. mohit: noted. I'll update styles and add a11y tests. sam: PR link when ready. tagging @anika for copy review. :thumbsup:
